description: Each data file is a JSON array of traditions. All user-facing text in Chinese. IDs globally unique prefixed by tradition. Coordinates [longitude,latitude]. Relations reference entity or artifact IDs. Cross-tradition entity links are supported. Importance tier 1 core, 2 important, 3 extended. Sources must be real researched direct URLs. Short quoted extracts include locator; mark translations. No invented historical certainty. Expansion files are objects with traditions arrays and per-entry enrichment. They append entities, events, relations, artifacts, groups and sources to the corresponding baseline tradition. Build never rewrites the baseline. Images from all enrichment layers merge additively.
